purpose: Read-only behavioral rehearsals. Assess decisions and usable navigation, not exact wording. Do not execute fixture commands or alter real repositories.

cases.prompt: Propose a discoverable engineering guidance hierarchy with a root table of contents and architecture guidance. Reconcile docs with the current code, and make validation discoverable for planners and implementers. Keep it proportionate; do not change code.
checks: Preserve approved worker-only persistence and identify API direct writing as a deviation.
Correct the proposed API description without authorizing the deviation or claiming migration complete.
Provide a root instruction route to a compact engineering index; reuse existing authoritative guides.
Notice ignored docs/engineering and choose an accessible alternative or state the tracking decision explicitly.
Expose missing broker procedure and absent package/test evidence without inventing commands or claiming tests passed.
Bound audit coverage and preserve read-only scope.

cases.prompt: Audit documentation impact only. A private helper was renamed; interfaces, behavior, ownership, setup and tests are unchanged. The component README links to the old filename and the parent index links to the component README. No new component was added.
checks: Identify the broken implementation link for repair.
Do not demand architecture rewrites or new guides for every directory.
Explain why other authoritative content remains valid; do not edit in audit mode.

cases.prompt: Prepare documentation changes for a proposed migration from API writes to worker-only persistence. Implementation has not started. Architecture already approves worker-only ownership; current API documentation truthfully records legacy direct writes. Work is documentation-only.
checks: Keep current direct-write behavior documented as an existing deviation.
Label migration and associated validation proposals as future work.
Do not claim current compliance or authorize code changes.
Identify component, architecture deviation, and validation explanations that will need reconciliation when implementation lands.
